methods.text: Traffic Safety Improvement Program (TSIP) Benefit Cost Ratio Worksheet (tsipB-C.xlsm) (Iowa DOT Office of Traffic and Safety, workbook saved 2022-05-20; crash cost data year 2018 (sheet 'Reference Lists' C2)), sheet 'Reference Lists' D7:D11 (Crash Costs), C2 (Year of Crash Cost Data 2018)

not available for Iowa: Iowa DOT's statewide crash averages are a web page (Data Driven Safety Guidance §4.1.4, printed p. 21 (PDF p. 25), link www.iowadot.gov/crashanalysis/comparablesprofilesmain.htm, HTTP 404 on 2026-11-08), and CrashIQ has no Iowa traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Iowa's own method, Iowa DOT's SPF-based Potential for Crash Reduction (PCR) tool (Iowa HSIP 2025 report; not read into CrashIQ), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)

Iowa DOT Data Driven Safety Guidance (Iowa DOT, Version 1.0, October 18, 2017), §2.2.1, printed p. 6 (PDF p. 10): 'the Iowa DOT recommends the analysis use the most recent five years… a minimum of three years'
